text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm about to run a 'chaos-slice' smokecheck for model `redwood/v2.3-int4` on staging canary. Goal: stress adversarial slices (long-reasoning, code, multi-turn) and verify autofallback triggers. Kicking off in ~10m. Criteria: hallucination delta > 2% OR MRR drop > 3% OR latency P99 > 1.5x baseline => autofallback. Sharing config below. @Maria can you watch the eval dashboard? @Jin watch infra?

Alex: ```
chaos_smokecheck:
  model: redwood/v2.3-int4
  slices: [long-reasoning, code-exec, multi-turn-history, low-prefix]
  load: small-batch-shadow
  sample_count: 5000
  thresholds:
    hallucination_delta_pct: 2.0
    mrr_drop_pct: 3.0
    latency_p99_mul: 1.5
  autofallback: true
  rollback_window_s: 300
```

Maria: On it. I'll pin the hallucination diffs and token-level edit distance view.

Jin: Infra green. GPUs warmed, swarm autoscaler on. I'll alert if queue depth > 40.

eval-bot: queued run `smoke-4287651234` -> run_id smoke-4287, slicing policy applied.

Sam: Do we want a contrastive shadow vs prod baseline run too, or just slice-weighted checks?

Alex: Run both. Shadow compare with 5k samples, slice-weighted (weight long-reasoning=2). We need a clear A/B table for MRR/hallucination by slice.

Claire: If autofallback fires, what's the fallback order? int8 nf4 then previous stable?

Alex: Fallback chain: `redwood/v2.2-nf4` -> `redwood/v1.9-stable`. Traffic routing policy will send affected route slices to fallback immediately. Full rollback only if >2 slices hit thresholds or system-wide MRR >3% drop.

Maria: Early results (first 1k samples): code-exec slice looks fine. long-reasoning shows hallucination_delta = +2.4% (exceeds 2.0%). MRR delta = -1.8% (within 3.0%). Latency P99 multiplier = 1.4 (within 1.5). My call: trigger partial fallback for route/tag `long-reasoning` only.

Jin: Triggering circuit-breaker for slice tag `long-reasoning` on canary. Applying traffic reduction to 0% for that route in canary.

deploy-bot: traffic-rewrite applied -> canary:redwood/v2.3-int4 (route: long-reasoning) redirected to fallback:redwood/v2.2-nf4; change_id=chg-ev-4287.

Sam: Good. Grab sampled prompts/responses for audit and open a ticket to root-cause prompt patterns that produced hallucination spikes. I'll annotate with top 10 failing prompts.

eval-bot: run-summary smoke-4287: hallucination_delta_long_reasoning=2.4%, mrr_delta_overall=-1.8%, latency_p99_mul=1.4. Serialized artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/smoke-4287/artifacts.tar.gz

Claire: :eyes: thanks Maria, nice triage.

Alex: OK team — leave the partial fallback in place for now. If the other slices stay green for next 1h, we'll resume gradual promotion tests; if we see a second slice fail or overall MRR crosses -3.0% we'll rollback full. I'll also open a PR to tune the long-reasoning sensitivity threshold vs perf tradeoff. cc @Sam

Maria: Filing follow-up doc now with examples and a short hypothesis list.

Jin: Noted. I'll keep autoscaler headroom at +20% for the next hour.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Quick wins: consider lowering hallucination threshold to 1.8% for long-reasoning in the gating config if this pattern recurs.

Sam: Agree — will include in ticket.

deploy-bot: note: changelog entry created -> chg-ev-4287 (partial fallback for long-reasoning).

Alex: End of thread for now — will post final status after 1h. :thumbsup:
